entries.content: peoples (c-12) Leummim, a general word for 'the races of mankind.'
earth. (g-21) Erets, 'land,' but the plural 'ends' seems to involve the meaning 'earth.' see 1Sam. 2.8,10; Ps. 72.8; Isa. 49.6; Acts 13.47.
little. (k-20) Or 'for soon his anger burneth.' trust (l-27) 'Take refuge,' as Ps. 61.4. same root word as 'refuge,' in Ps. 14.6, &c., and 'trust' in 2Sam. 22.3.
trouble (m-18) See Ps. 8.2, 'adversaries' and Note o.

Selah. (a-14) 'Selah' is said to mean a pause. Some take it as a direction to the singers to raise their voices. Selah occurs 74 times in the O.T.. 71 in the Psalms, 17 in first book, 30 in second, 20 in third, 4 in fifth; and 3 in Habakkuk.
call, (b-14) It is abstract, 'in my calling.' so ver. 3.

pious (c-9) Chasid, an adjective used of man and of God; it is translated 'holy,' 'pious,' 'saint,' 'gracious.' Chesed is the noun meaning 'piety' and recognition of God on man's part, and of 'grace' and 'loving-kindness' on God's part. see 2Chron. 6.42.
Offer (e-1) As Ex. 23.18; Ps. 50.14. confide (f-6) * Implying 'security without anxiety,' and so elsewhere.
safety. (g-20) Or 'for thou, Jehovah, makest me [although] alone [yet] to dwell,' &c.. see Deut. 33. 28.
fools (l-2) Or 'the boastful,' 'the arrogant,' as Ps. 73.3. workers (m-12) The Hebrew word is used for 'mighty deeds,' 'achievements,' and is common in the Psalms. see Job 31.3; 34.8,22.
in (n-5) Or 'through.' loving-kindness (a-10) Chesed. see Ps. 4.3. temple (b-22) Or 'palace.'
perversion, (d-13) 'Corrupt, depraved desires,' 'wickedness;' 'mischievous things,' Ps. 38.12. the word is plural. with (e-22) Lit. 'make smooth.'
shield. (f-18) Here the larger shield, one which screened the whole body. 'buckler,' Ps. 35.2; 91.4.
Sheminith. (g-9) Perhaps 'upon the octave,' or 'with eight strings.' see Ps. 12; 1Chron. 15.21.
Sheol (h-11) i.e. 'Hades;' it vaguely expresses the place or state of the soul separated from the body. thee? (i-17) Or 'celebrate thy praises.'
Shiggaion (l-1) According to some, it means 'elegy.'
that (m-19) Or 'or have despoiled him that,' &c.
glory (a-24) Or 'cause mine honour to dwell.'
sakes (b-13) Or 'over them,' or 'above it,' i.e. 'the assembly.'
peoples. (c-7) Ammim, the peoples in connection with Israel, brought into relationship with Israel. me. (d-23) Or 'be it unto me.'
judge, (e-5) Or 'God judgeth the righteous.' day. (f-14) Or 'and *God is angry in every day.'
one (g-2) Or, 'if he,' i.e. 'the wicked one.' ready, (h-18) Or 'adjusted it.'
Gittith. (l-7) * See also Ps. 81 and 84. A musical instrument. The word is feminine. set (m-26) Possibly imperative, it would then read, '... earth! because of which set thou,' &c.

praise (n-12) Or 'founded strength;' same word as in Ps. 68.34; 96.6,7; 132.8. adversaries, (o-16) Tzar, the 'adversary' of Christ, or 'oppressor' of the remnant, from within, as Ps. 3.1; 27.2,12. enemy (p-20) Oyeb, external 'enemy,' as Ex. 15.9; 23.22; Num. 10.35.
man, (q-3) Enosh, 'feeble,' 'mortal man,' man looked at as a race, in contrast with distinguished individuals. see Gen. 4.26; Ps. 144.3. man, (r-14) Adam. visitest (s-17) Or 'regardest.'
little (t-6) Or 'some little.' angels, (u-10) Elohim. see Ps. 97.7.
wicked; (b-10) The word is in the singular, and as such, characteristic; so in ver. 16. it is plural in ver. 17.
perished. (c-20) Or 'their memorial hath perished [along with] them,' or 'even theirs.'
world (d-9) Tebel, the habitable earth. see 1Sam. 2.8; Ps 19.4; 24.1; 33.8; 98.7,9, &c.; Prov. 8.31.
refuge (e-6) refuge (e-12) Strictly, 'high fortress;' 'high tower,' Ps. 18.2.
he (f-8) Or 'For he that requireth blood.'
Higgaion. (h-21) This may mean, 'to be played on the harp;' if not 'meditate.' Same word as Ps. 19.14; 92.3; Lam. 3.62.
meek (i-14) Plural, or 'the afflicted ones;' 'meek' and 'afflicted' are connected in Hebrew.
afflicted. (a-10) Or 'Through the pride of the wicked [man], the afflicted is sore pressed.'
out. (b-14) Or 'The wicked in his haughtiness doth not seek [God];' or 'troubleth himself for nothing.'
ones. (d-14) An allusion probably to 'fangs [of a lion].'
afflicted. (e-12) Others, 'the meek,' as also in Ps. 9.12. see 9.18.
trouble (f-9) Or 'mischief,' as ver. 7. by (g-14) Or 'to put it into.' himself (h-20) Or 'it.'
wicked, (a-8) See Note, Ps. 9.5. here the singular.
be (b-15) Or 'snares. fire and brimstone and a scorching wind shall be.'
righteousness, (c-7) Lit. 'righteousnesses.' see Note, Rev. 19.8. upright. (d-13) Or 'the upright shall see his face.'
Sheminith. (e-6) See Ps. 6, title. gone; (f-18) Or 'ceaseth.'
falsehood (g-3) Or 'vanity.' heart, (h-15) Lit. 'a heart and a heart.'
them (m-9) Or 'him.' see end of ver. 5.
(o-0) With this Psalm compare Ps. 53. fool (p-10) Nabal. see Ps. 53.1.
Michtam (c-1) Meaning doubtful. According to some, 'a golden jewel.' See Ps. 56-60.

To (d-1) The preposition is the same as before 'Jehovah' in ver. 2. but 'to' before 'thee,' at the end of ver. 2, is different. saints (e-3) Kadoshim. plural of Kadosh, which is used of God in Ps. 22.3; 71.22; 78.41; 89.18; 99.3,5; Hab. 1.12, &c., and is translated 'holy' -- 'holy one.' It is used of 'Aaron,' Ps. 106.16.
lines (g-2) Or 'portions.' see Josh. 17.5,14. fallen (h-4) See Mic. 2.5.
glory (i-7) Or 'honour.' In Acts 2.26, 'tongue,' from the LXX. But see Gen. 49.6. It may be taken as a synonym of 'soul.' see Ps. 7.5. hope. (k-15) Or 'shall rest in safety,' as Ps. 4.8.
Sheol, (l-9) See Notes to Ps. 6.5 and Matt. 11.23. One (m-16) Or 'gracious one,' chasid. see Notes to Ps. 4.3; 30.4.
from (c-15) Or 'I have paid attention to.'
paths, (d-8) Or 'Hold my goings in thy paths, that my ...'
us (h-5) Or 'me.' earth. (i-18) Or 'they set their eyes to cast [us] down to the earth.'
are] (l-4) Or '[by].' age. (m-13) Cheled or 'world.' so Ps. 49.1; 'life,' Ps. 89.47 and Job 11.17; also 'lifetime,' Ps. 39.5. sons, (n-34) Or [their] sons are surfeited.'
enemies (p-37) As 8.2; so vers. 3,17,37,40,48 Saul. (q-44) Compare 2Sam. 22 throughout, and Notes there.
rock, (r-4) Sela, 'a high rock,' see Isa. 16.1.
enemies]; (a-9) Lit. 'and scattered them.' lightnings, (b-14) Or 'and many lightnings.'
gracious (e-3) Chasid. see Notes, 2Sam. 22.26; 2Chron. 6.42. gracious; (f-8) Chesed. see 2Chron. 6.42.
word (a-9) Imrah. see Ps. 119.11. tried. (b-13) Or 'refined.' see Ps. 12.6.
uttereth (g-4) Lit. 'causeth to boil forth,' 'gush,' as of a stream, as Ps. 145.7.
line (h-2) That is, the 'extent' of their testimony.
[sins]; (d-8) Or 'from the presumptuous.' transgression. (e-28) Or 'from the great transgression.'
thee; (f-25) Or 'set thee up on high.'
accept (g-6) Or 'turn to ashes;' or 'let thy burnt-offering be fat to him.'
call. (h-12) Or 'Let Jehovah save the king. Let him answer,' &c.
Aijeleth-Shahar. (b-6) That is, 'According to the hind of the morning.' Aijeleth is feminine.
generation. (c-15) Or 'it shall be told concerning the Lord to the [coming] generation.' but see Ps. 87.6.
world, (g-14) Tebel, 'the habitable earth.' see Ps. 9.8.
David.} (c-4) An acrostic Psalm; the verses begin with the Hebrew letters in alphabetical succession, as Ps. 34.
earth. (g-13) Or 'possess the land,' as Ps. 37.9,29.
secret (h-2) i.e. 'the intimate (or private) communications.' them. (i-19) Or 'and his covenant, -- to make them know [it].'
bring (k-8) Some read 'Enlarge my heart in its troubles, and bring ...' Others read 'The troubles of my heart relieve thou, and bring ...'

afraid? (e-28) 'Fear' and 'be afraid' are nearly the same, but it seems that the latter is more 'terror,' even used of Jehovah. see 1Sam. 11.7; Ps. 36.1; 'fear' more in a godly sense, as Prov. 1.7, yet ver. 3 here does mean simple 'fear.'
beauty (g-31) Or 'graciousness,' and so in Ps. 90.17.
up. (a-15) Or 'For my father and my mother have forsaken me, but Jehovah hath gathered me.'
enemies. (b-16) Or 'those that lie in wait for me.'
courage. (c-11) Or 'he will strengthen thy heart.'
For (d-1) Or 'Because they regard not ... his hands, he will destroy,' &c.
say, (a-22) Or perhaps, 'everything saith;' the Hebrew is the same as 'every one' in Isa. 1.23.
flood; (b-5) The word used in Gen. 6.17 of the deluge.
me, (c-18) Strictly, 'drawn me up,' as out of a well.

saints (d-6) Chasid. those characterized by piety, grace, goodness; see Ps. 16.10, and Note on 2Chron. 6.42. 'Saints,' Ps. 16.3, is Kadoshim, 'holy ones.' holiness. (e-16) Or 'celebrate his holy (Kodesh) memorial,' i.e. his holy name. see Ex. 3.15.
praise (g-18) Or 'give thanks to;' and so ver. 12.
rock (i-5) Sela, as in Ps. 18.2, first time.
iniquity, (a-18) Or 'my misery (distress);' but as meaning 'punishment.'
thee. (a-23) Or 'I will give counsel, with,' &c.
(a-0) An acrostic Psalm, arranged as Ps. 25. Abimelech, (b-11) Meaning, 'Father-king;' most probably the title of the Philistine kings.
man (d-11) Geber. so Ps. 40.4. see Job. 3.3.
destroy (e-3) Or 'destroyeth utterly.' it is the intensive form of the verb. see 1Sam. 17.51. guilt. (f-15) Or 'shall be condemned.'
witnesses (a-2) Lit. 'witnesses of violence,' as Deut. 19.16. charge (b-9) Or 'question me about.'
people. (g-16) Or 'in the midst of a great (or mighty) people.'
uttereth (a-19) As an oracle. see 'saith,' Gen. 22.16.
(e-0) An acrostic Psalm with double verses. see Ps.25.
unto (g-4) Lit. 'Roll thy way upon.' see Ps. 22.8.
land. (i-17) Or 'the earth;' and so in vers. 11,22,29,34. see Ps. 25.13 and Note, Matt. 5.5.
lambs. (b-17) Others, 'the splendour of the meadows.'
man (c-5) Geber, as Ps. 34.8. see Job 3.3, and cf. Job 4.17.
peace; (g-15) Or 'for there is a future to the man of peace.'

wrath; (a-15) It is 'indignation.' from the idea of breaking out into anger.' displeasure. (b-22) 'Hot displeasure,' ('fury,' Ps. 88.7), would be rather stronger. Both words (notes a and b) are of discipline.
indignation; (d-11) 'Punitive anger against evil.' the same word is in Ps. 69.24; 78.49; 102,10.
stroke; (h-10) Or 'plague,' as Gen. 12.17; and so in Ps. 39.10.
adversaries (k-9) Heb. plural of Satan, as Ps. 71.13; 109.4,20,29. Sing. in 1Chron. 21.1; Job 1 and 2; Ps. 109.6; Zech. 3.1,2.
show; (b-7) Lit. 'in an image (shadow).' vain; (c-13) Or 'for vanity,' as vers. 5,11. Job. 7.16.
Sacrifice (g-1) See Ex. 23.18 and Lev. 1.3, Note b. prepared (h-11) Lit. 'digged' or 'hollowed out.'
iniquities (l-9) Or 'my punishments.' Gen. 19.15. see; (m-19) Or 'look at them.'
land; (d-16) Or 'on the earth.' enemies. (e-28) As Ps. 8.2; also vers. 5,11.
hurt. (g-15) Or 'they impute evil to me.'
friend, (i-5) Lit. 'the man (ish) of my peace.' See Ps. 55.13.
praise (b-20) Or 'thank.' so ver. 11; Ps. 43.4,5; 44.8. health (c-24) Lit. 'salvations;' and so ver. 11; Ps. 43.5; 53.6; 116.13.
I (d-12) Or 'because I.' Mizar. (e-26) Or 'from the little hill.'
me, (g-2) That is, as often, 'Do me justice.' ungodly (h-11) Heb. goi lo-chasid, 'nation not-merciful.' see Isa. 1.4 -- contrast to Ps. 86.2. see Ps. 4.3.
habitations. (i-23) Or 'tabernacles;' and so Ps. 46.4; 84.1; 132.7. see Ex. 25.9; Lev. 26.11.
peoples, (a-18) Leummim, as Ps. 2.1; and so ver. 14.
thyself (b-2) Lit. 'Thou, He.' 'Thou [art] the Same.' see Deut. 32.39, Ps. 102.27 deliverance (c-9) Lit. 'salvations;' see note c, Ps. 42.5.
price; (d-16) Or 'hast not increased their price.'
Shoshannim. (f-6) Meaning, 'Lilies.' composed (g-34) Or 'my occupation,' as Gen. 46.33.
glad. (a-18) Or 'from which they have gladdened thee.'
within; (d-7) i.e. in the royal apartments.
peoples (c-15) As Ps. 7.8. thee (f-17) Or 'give thee thanks.'
peoples (a-4) Ammim. Ps. 7.8. nations (b-9) Leummim. see Ps. 2.1.
peoples (a-5) people (a-11) Ammim. Ps. 7.8. willing-hearted (e-2) Or 'The nobles,' 'liberal.' [with] (f-9) Or 'are joined unto.' see Gen. 49.10. shields (g-22) See Note, Hos. 4.18.
as (i-7) Or 'God is in her palaces. he is known as.'
peoples; (a-16) Ammim. Ps. 7.8. world. (b-23) Or 'age.' see Ps. 17.14.
degree, (c-9) Lit. 'Both sons of Adam and sons of Ish.'
supplanters (e-15) Or 'of them who would trip me up.'
names. (g-24) Or 'their names are proclaimed in the lands.'
power (i-9) Lit. 'hand.' receive (k-15) Or 'take,' as Gen. 5.24.
bulls, (f-7) Strictly 'the strong ones,' as Ps. 22.12; 68.30.
Offer (g-1) Lit. 'Sacrifice,' as Deut. 12.15; Ps. 4.5. see Lev. 7.11; 17.5-7.
offereth (g-2) Lit. 'Sacrifice,' as Deut. 12.15; Ps. 4.5. see Lev. 7.11; 17.5-7. praise (l-3) Or 'thanksgiving.'
me. (d-15) Or 'uphold me with a willing spirit.'
have (e-4) Or 'take delight in.' see vers. 6,16.
man (h-3) Geber. see Ps. 34.8 and Job 3.3.
thee (i-4) Or 'give thee thanks,' and so Ps. 67.3,5. good. (k-26) Or 'and I will wait on thy name; because it is good before thy godly ones.'
Mahalath. (a-6) The meaning is uncertain. fool (b-12) As Ps. 14.1. see Notes, 1Sam. 25.3,25.
salvation (c-4) Lit. 'salvations,' as Ps. 42.5. captivity (d-17) See Ps. 126.1 and Note.
sacrifice (f-4) Or 'I will sacrifice a freewill offering.' praise (g-9) See Note b, Ps. 42.5. good. (h-17) Or 'thou art good.'
wicked. (l-14) As Ps. 9.5. iniquity (m-18) Or 'vanity;' it is inwardly devised evil. see Job 4.8; 15.35; Pa 7.14; 10.7; 66.18; 90.10.
Perversities (b-1) See Ps. 5.9 and Note d. streets. (c-15) Or 'open place.'
them, (e-5) Some read 'Desolation be upon them!'
seated (f-10) Or 'that abideth.' they (g-23) Or 'because they with whom are no changes.'
mouth, (h-8) Or '[The words of] his mouth were smooth as butter.'
burden (i-3) Or 'the portion assigned to thee.'

Jonathelem-rechokim. (k-6) 'The mute dove in the distance,' or 'the dove of the distant terebinths.' Michtam; (l-9) See Ps. 16. man (m-24) Enosh. up. (n-28) Strictly, 'pant after me,' like a wild beast thirsting for blood; and so Ps. 57.3; Amos 8.4.
up (n-6) Strictly, 'pant after me,' like a wild beast thirsting for blood; and so Ps. 57.3; Amos 8.4. haughtily. (o-19) Or 'O Most High!' as Ps. 92.8.
countest (b-2) Or 'recountest.' bottle. (c-10) There is a paronomasia in this verse with Nod, 'wandering,' and N“d, 'bottle' (i.e. a leathern sack).
earth! (i-15) Or 'land,' erets, as also ver. 11, Ps. 58.2; 1Sam. 2.8; &c.
down. (k-13) Or 'they bowed down my soul.'
glory; (l-3) See Ps. 16.9. wake (m-10) Or 'awake with;' and so Ps. 108.2.
nations. (n-19) Leummim. see Ps. 2.1; and so Ps. 67.4; 108.3.
Michtam.} (f-9) See Ps. 16. it? (p-17) Some would read 'Do ye mighty ones indeed speak righteousness?'
earth. (i-17) Or 'land,' erets, as also ver. 11, Ps. 58.2; 1Sam. 2.8; &c. out (q-9) Or 'ponder.'
loving-kindness (c-3) Or 'The God of my mercy (chesed),' as ver. 17.
lips, (d-12) Or '[Because] the sin of their mouth is the word of their lips.'
refuge (a-33) Strictly, 'place of escape,' as Job 11.20.
Shushan. (c-6) Meaning, 'lily.' For michtam see Ps. 16 and Ps. 56 to 60.
adversaries. (g-16) As Ps. 8.2; or 'oppressors.' see Ps. 108.6-13.
earth (d-6) As Ps. 58.2. me. (h-30) Or 'which is higher than I.'
sojourn (i-3) refuge (i-12) Or 'Let me sojourn -- let me take refuge.' cohortatives.
Jeduthun. (a-6) * As Ps. 39 and 77, meaning 'praising' or 'celebrating.' peacefully; (b-18) Or 'wait in silence,' as Ps. 65.1.
peacefully; (b-8) Or 'wait in silence,' as Ps. 65.1.
degree (c-4) degree, (c-11) See Note, Ps. 49.2. vanity; (d-7) vanity. (d-24) As Job 7.16; Ps. 39.5,6,11.
forgive (b-10) Lit. 'make atonement,' as Lev. 16.30; Deut. 21.8; Ps. 78.38; 79.9. see Note g, Lev. 5.6.
temple. (c-30) Or 'of the temple of thy holiness.'
earth, (f-5) As Ps. 58.2. it; (g-9) Or 'made it overflow.' their (h-24) i.e. of men. it. (i-31) i.e. the earth.
abundance. (d-24) 'Runneth over,' in Ps. 23.5, is the same word.
peoples (b-3) peoples (b-11) Ammim. see Ps. 7.8. praise (f-4) See Note i, Ps. 52.9.
peoples (b-14) Ammim. see Ps. 7.8. nations (g-3) nations (g-18) Leummim. see Ps. 2.1.
peoples (b-3) peoples (b-11) Ammim. see Ps. 7.8. praise (f-4) See Note i, Ps. 52.9.

for (b-12) Or 'triumph in.' Jah; (c-22) The existing One, objectively. Jah occurs 43 times from Psalms 68 to 150 and 7 times elsewhere -- Ex. 15.2, see Note; 17.16; Cant. 8.6; Isa. 12.2; 26.4; 38.11 (twice).
families; (d-6) Or 'maketh the solitary to dwell in a home.' bound (e-10) Or 'prisoners,' as Ps. 69.33.
rain (g-8) Or 'a rain of free gifts.'
flock (h-2) Or 'living assembly,' 'incorporated people;' as 'troop,' Ps. 74.19.
word. (i-5) Omer. see Note, Ps. 119.11. publishers. (k-11) i.e. women publishing victory, like Miriam. the word is feminine, see Ex. 15.20; 1Sam. 18.6.
sheepfolds, (l-7) Others, 'pots' or 'ash-grates,' but see Judg. 5.16. green (m-23) Strictly, 'greenish-yellow.'
God, (o-8) Or 'A mount of God is mount Bashan.'
Man, (p-16) i.e. as man (Adam), in connection with mankind. dwelling (q-24) See Ex. 25.8.
salvation; (r-7) Or '*God is for us a *God of salvations.'
redeemer; (b-8) See Note, Lev. 25.25; it is rendered also 'avenger,' Num. 35.12. see Ruth 3.13; 4.8,14.
gall (d-5) A bitter (poisonous?) plant. see Jer. 8.14; 23.15.
side. (b-11) Or 'and thou wilt turn and comfort me.'
thee (c-5) Or 'give thee thanks.' psaltery, (d-8) Lit. 'an instrument, a lute.'
endure, (h-11) Lit. 'with the sun and before the moon.' see 'as long as the sun,' lit. 'before the sun,' ver. 17. generation. (i-15) Lit. 'generation of generations.'
turn (d-4) Or 'Therefore he turns his people.'
world. (e-11) Or 'and they are ever at rest' (i.e. careless). see Ezek. 23.42.
redeemed (b-13) As Ps. 69.18, &c. portion (c-17) Lit. 'staff [for measuring];' or 'tribe.'
adversaries (d-2) Tzar, Ps. 8.2. signs. (e-18) See Ex. 4.17; 10.2.
habitation (f-12) Mishkan, used for 'tabernacle,' Ex. 25.9, &c.; 2Chron. 29.6, Ps. 78.60. Also 'dwelleth,' Ps. 26.8.
leviathan, (h-9) As Job 3.8. those (i-17) i.e. the wild beasts.
moon (k-14) Lit. 'light-bearer,' i.e. what gives light, as Gen. 1.14-16; Ex. 25.6.
foolish (l-11) Or 'vile,' 'impious.' see ver. 22 and Ps. 53.1.
beast; (m-12) Or 'Give not up thy turtle-dove unto the greedy troop' (or 'herd'). troop (n-16) Others, 'life,' as 'flock,' Ps. 68.10.
assembly, (a-6) Or 'When I shall reach (seize) the set time.' see Lev. 23.2.
south (c-14) Lit. 'the wilderness,' which was in the south.
out (b-15) Or 'was poured out,' or, 'my sore ran.'
works (d-6) Strictly, 'doings,' 'exploits,' Prov. 20.11; Mic. 2.7; 'doings' in ver. 12 and Ps. 78.11 is rather 'actions.' 'work' in ver. 12 is a 'thing done,' as Isa. 45.9.
Zoan. (b-19) i.e. Tanis, a town in Lower Egypt.
provoking (d-9) Or 'rebelling against;' and so ver. 40.
flattered (b-3) The word means, 'make pretence,' elsewhere 'entice,' 'deceive.'
dog-flies (f-3) Or 'vermin;' but it is as in Ex. 8.21.
caterpillar, (g-8) Lit. 'the devourer,' a species of locust. so 1Kings 8.37; 2Chron. 6.28. see Joel 1.4.
Psalm.} (a-10) Or 'On lilies. A testimony of Asaph. a Psalm.' cherubim, (b-29) Or 'dwellest above the cherubim,' so Ps. 99.1; but there the article is omitted before 'cherubim.'
which (g-4) Others, 'And protect that which.' plant (h-13) Lit. 'the son.'
time, (l-11) Others, 'at the full moon,' as Prov. 7.20; but it more probably refers to special appointment or 'reckoning,' according to the word in the original.
wheat; (a-11) Lit. 'the fat of wheat,' and so Ps. 147.14.
Judge (c-1) That is, as often, 'Judge in favour of.'
Jehovah, (b-11) Or 'who alone hast the name Jehovah.' High (c-15) Heb. Elyon. see Gen. 14.19, and note the omission here of 'possessor of heavens,' cf. Deut. 32.8.
Baca, (e-6) Or 'of weeping.' rain (f-15) See Deut. 11.14. The autumn rain. the first with reference to the time of sowing.
ones. (a-21) Or 'saints' (chasid). see Note c and 2 Chron. 6.41,42.
way. (b-13) Or 'shall set [itself] in the way of his steps.'
godly; (c-7) Or 'pious,' 'holy,' chasid, one who is the object of God's loving-kindness (chesed). see ver. 13 and Ps. 85.7,10, and Note to Ps. 4.3; and, by way of contrast, Ps. 43.1.
goodness (f-16) Or 'loving-kindness,' chesed, as in vers. 5,13, and Ps. 103.8. see Ex.34.6.
Leannoth. (e-16) The meaning of Mahalath is uncertain, see Ps. 53. Leannoth may mean 'for subdued singing.'
Prostrate (g-1) Or 'Cast away.' hand. (h-25) i.e. 'from thy leading and helping hand.'
wonders (l-4) Lit. 'wonder.' shades (m-10) Or 'the dead,' as Job 26.5; Prov. 2.18; Isa. 14.9; not the same as 'dead' in this verse.
anger (a-3) The Hebrew word is plural.

*word (k-2) It may be well to notice the distinction between Dabar and Imrah, so frequent in this Psalm. Dabar is 'word,' agreeing with Logos in the New Testament; Omer and Imrah mean 'a word,' 'speech,' 'what is said,' and, if we except Josh. 24.27, are only used in poetic style. The latter form (Imrah), which is feminine, alone occurs here; 'saying' might have done for it, were it not otherwise objectionable. It fixes the mind more especially on what is expressed, having thus occasionally the force of 'promise' (Omer), as Ps. 77.8, or 'command' (Imrah), as Ps. 147.15. In the sense of 'word' Imrah is found twenty-six times, of which nineteen are in this Psalm, where it is distinguished from Dabar by a dot (*) placed before 'word.' A modified form, also in the sense of 'word,' is found in Lam. 2.17.
